annotations.title: Lock or unlock a domain for transfers

description: Turn the registrar (transfer) lock on or off for a domain registered at GlobalHostia. Locked domains cannot be transferred to another registrar. Unlocking needs confirm: true after the customer approves; locking does not.

confirm.description: Must be true. Set it only after the customer has explicitly confirmed this exact change.

domain.description: A domain on your account, e.g. mybrand.com

name: set_registrar_lock
title: Lock or unlock a domain for transfers
